resources.string: Screen recording at the original quality, straight from the hardware encoder, with no second compression
Higher frame rate and resolution mean bigger files; the real numbers appear in the report after every recording. Changing any option below switches to Custom.
Native resolution at the highest frame rate the phone\'s encoder supports (120 or 165): smoother, but bigger files and a warmer phone in busy games.
Recommended for games: native resolution at 60 fps; every frame sharp, no blocks in busy scenes, cooler and smaller; good for YouTube.
Native resolution, 30 fps and a lower bitrate; the smallest files.
Auto: same as the screen; if the phone rotates while recording, recording continues in a new part with no stretching. Portrait/Landscape: fixed, the other orientation gets black bars.
Native = exactly what you see on screen (%1$s). Nothing above the screen (e.g. 4K) is offered: it would only add size, not detail.
Pictures per second. Screen = the display\'s highest refresh rate; if the encoder can\'t keep up, a lower rate is used and shown.
Auto: hardware AV1 (if present) → HEVC → H.264. AV1 and HEVC give much better quality at the same size; H.264 works with older editors.
Auto is computed from resolution × frame rate; fast motion may peak at 4× so it does not turn blocky.
VBR (recommended): static screens cost almost nothing. CBR: always constant and large. CQ: constant quality, unknown and usually very large size.
Internal audio is only captured from games that allow it. Quality: 48 kHz stereo, AAC 320 kbps.
Raise it if your voice is quiet.
A small visible panel with stop, pause, mic, face cam, delete and hide; drag it to an edge, tap its header to shrink it to a dot.

Ask every time: Android\'s window comes before each recording and you choose the whole screen or just one app (a game, say). Only the first time: it asks once, later recordings start without it until the screen locks or you tap «End» in the notification.

Android asks before every recording. With this only the first time shows the window; the next recordings start with one tap and no window until the screen locks, the tablet restarts or you tap «End» in the notification. Meanwhile the screen-sharing sign stays in the status bar (nothing is recorded until you tap).
One tap starts recording, no permission window. Nothing is recorded until you tap «Record».

While not recording, a small round button stays at the screen\'s edge (over games too): one tap and recording starts right there, without opening the app. Drag to move, hold to open RawRec. Never in the video.
Record button closed; it comes back when you open RawRec.
Tap again to end the recording
A small notification always stays in the shade; tap «Record» whenever you want (in a game too). Android asks its permission once before each recording.
Keep the control out of the video

Off (default): the six-button control is on the screen while recording and shrinks to a small dot after 5 s (it shows in the video too). On: While recording nothing of RawRec is on the screen. Shake the phone firmly three times (or tap «Show control» in the notification) to see the control. The recording pauses itself while the control is open, so viewers never see it; «Continue» takes it away and the recording goes on.
When recording starts the control shrinks to a small visible dot at the edge; tap it to open. Nothing is ever invisible.
Several firm, deliberate back-and-forth shakes end the recording; walking, bumps or an intense game do not.

Front-camera bubble; it is on screen, so it appears in the video.
You can always stop from the notification and the RawRec Quick Settings tile; if you hid the control, «Show control» in the notification brings it back.

The recording control sits at the screen edge: tap to open, drag to move, «hide» takes it away.
Each permission is needed only for what is written next to it. Screen capture is asked separately every time.
For the stop button in the notification and the “saved” message.

If the screen turns in the first 20 seconds (you open the game, say), recording starts over in the new orientation at the game\'s full size and stays one file (those first seconds are dropped).
A new file for each rotation

Off (recommended): every recording is one file, even an hour long. A game is never recorded small: turning from portrait to landscape after the first 20 seconds continues the game at full size, and turning back to portrait does not start a new file. On: a new file for each rotation.
The video comes out already edited: sharpness, contrast, colour, brightness and warmth. A very light job for the GPU, no noticeable effect on games. «Natural» means no change at all.

• Natural: the video exactly as recorded, no change.
• Clear: only sharper; edges, text and far things clearer, colours untouched.
• Vivid for games (recommended): sharper, livelier colours, deeper shadows; close to what the tablet's screen shows.
• Cinematic: strong contrast, calmer slightly warm colours, like a film.
Below, each part can be set on its own.
Makes edges and fine detail (text, hair, cloth and weapon texture) crisper. Too much makes edges look hard.
The gap between dark and light. More: darker shadows, brighter lights, more depth. Softer: a softer, flatter picture.
How strong the colours are. Vivid: dull colours come alive, skin stays natural. Calmer: softer colours.
The whole picture a little brighter or darker. «Brighter» helps in very dark games.
Warmer: a touch of yellow and orange (sunlight). Cooler: a touch of blue (night, metal).

To read and write the chat YouTube wants a «key» from your own Google account (free):

1. Go to console.cloud.google.com and create a new project.
2. «APIs & Services» → «Library» → «YouTube Data API v3» → Enable.
3. «OAuth consent screen»: type External, app name e.g. RawRec and your email. In «Audience» → «Test users» add your own email.
4. «Credentials» → «Create credentials» → «OAuth client ID» → type «TVs and Limited Input devices» → Create.
5. Paste the Client ID and Client secret above and tap «Sign in to YouTube».

Note: while the app is in Testing, Google asks to sign in again every 7 days. To make it permanent tap «Publish app» in «Audience»; when signing in, pass the «unverified» warning once with «Advanced → Go to RawRec».
